text:
Type: abstract printed low-pile rug
Use: adding a bold art piece to the floor; living room, kids' room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: short dense low pile
Colors: cobalt and sky blue, black, white, blush pink, mustard yellow
Shape: rectangular, flat low pile, large hand-drawn clouds with fine black and white striations, raindrops and a yellow sun, graphic and loud
Feel: playful, artistic, bold, cheerful
Goes with: white walls, solid neutral sofas, light wood, blue accents; eclectic modern or creative rooms

product.name: DOFTRANKA
product.description: The thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
